raw_segments.text: Portia, I should not need if you were gentle Brutus. Within the bond of marriage, tell
me, Brutus, is it accepted I should know no secrets that appertain to you? Am I yourself
but, as it were, in sort or limitation to keep with you at meals, comfort your bed and
talk to you sometimes? Dwell I but in the suburbs of your good pleasure. If it be no
more, Portia is Brutus Harlot, not his wife.
